# UI references for coding agents

> Index of 235 component libraries, motion/GSAP resources, shaders, theming tools and agent skills for building interfaces, grouped by the job they do in a build. Valid as of 2026-10-09. Tags are partly automated; see README.md. Items marked "unverified" are guesses.

## Start here

- [Graphical](https://www.graphicalui.com/): Create visual themes and customize components; built to work with a coding agent.
- [knadh/oat: Ultra-lightweight, zero dependency, semantic HTML/CSS/JS UI library](https://github.com/knadh/oat): Ultra-lightweight, zero-dependency semantic HTML/CSS/JS UI library.
- [Pixel Perfect UI — Lightweight UI Library for React](https://www.pixel-perfect.space/): Lightweight React UI library and Framer Motion blocks.
- [SmolCSS](https://smolcss.dev/): Small CSS snippets.
- [The Component Gallery](https://component.gallery/): The Component Gallery: how real design systems name and build components.
- [Amicro — Premium React Micro-transitions & Interaction Components](https://amicro.vercel.app/): React micro-transitions, installable via shadcn registry.
- [Animation Vocabulary — A Glossary of Animation Patterns](https://animations.samkalok.com/): 91 named animation patterns, for briefing an AI or designer on motion.
- [apple-design Skill - emilkowalski | UI Skills](https://www.ui-skills.com/skills/emilkowalski/apple-design): Registry of skills for design engineers, aimed at coding agents.
- [Fancy Components](https://www.fancycomponents.dev/): Playful React/TypeScript/Tailwind/Motion components.
- [Framer Motion Components | Pixel Perfect UI](https://www.pixel-perfect.space/blocks/motion): Lightweight React UI library and Framer Motion blocks.
- [Interface Craft](https://www.interfacecraft.dev/): Interface Craft, a working library for designing with care.
- [Motion (formerly Framer Motion)](https://motion.dev/): Motion (formerly Framer Motion): JavaScript and React animation library.
- [Motionwind — Motion animations as Tailwind classes](https://www.motionwind.xyz/): Motion animations as Tailwind-style utility classes; docs written for LLMs.
- [Originkit — Free Animated component library for modern websites](https://www.originkit.dev/): Free animated component library.
- [React UI Components | ObsidianUI](https://www.obsidianui.dev/components): React components with full source downloads.
- [The Vocabulary of Motion](https://motion-vocabulary.vercel.app/): A vocabulary of UI motion terms.
- [Transitions.dev: UI transitions for AI agents](https://transitions.dev/): UI transitions aimed at AI agents.
- [GSAP Motion Components for React & Vue | Annnimate](https://annnimate.com/): GSAP motion components for React and Vue. Paid library.
- [Lenis – Get smooth or die trying](https://lenis.studiofreight.com/): Lenis: smooth scroll.
- [The GSAP Field™ — A motion playground by BYQ](https://the-gsap-field.webflow.io/): A GSAP motion playground.
- [slot-text — tiny text roll animation](https://textmotion.dev/): slot-text: tiny text roll animation.
- [Generative Loaders — text, inline, and image loaders for React](https://generativeloaders.com/): Text, inline and image loaders for React.
- [Thinking Orbs - AI Status Indicator Components for React](https://www.thinkingorbs.com/): Animated status orbs for AI agent UIs (thinking, searching, compacting).
- [Canvas UI: Creative Canvas and WebGL Component Library](https://canvasui.dev/): Canvas/WebGL effect components, framework-agnostic. Ships a shadcn registry.
- [Paper Shaders – Ultra-fast zero-dependency shaders](https://shaders.paper.design/): Zero-dependency shaders for React and GLSL; full docs for LLMs.
- [Retro Dither | Canvas UI](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/retro-dither): Canvas/WebGL effect components, framework-agnostic. Ships a shadcn registry.
- [tweakcn: themes for shadcn/ui](https://tweakcn.com/): Visual theme editor and generator for shadcn/ui.
- [emilkowalski/skills](https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills): Skills for design engineers, for coding agents.
- [ibelick/ui-skills](https://github.com/ibelick/ui-skills): Skills for design engineers, for coding agents.
- [DesEngs: Resources for Design Engineers](https://desengs.com/): Resources for design engineers.
